_note: Scored questions are settled by core/forecast.py against realised spot candles (resolver types: close_gt, ret_gt, ret_lt, ret_bucket, vol_gt). Questions with "scored": false are asked for context only, are never logged to forecasts.jsonl and can never feed the veto gate (they cannot be settled from candles). score = probability 0-100 of the resolver's 'yes'.

questions.text: Will {coin} close the next daily bar (24h) above the last daily close?
Probability (0-100) that {coin} falls more than 5% over the next 24h (next daily close vs last daily close)
Will {coin} close higher in 7 days than at the last close?
What will {coin}'s 7-day return (close in 7 days vs last close) be?
Probability (0-100) that {coin} gains more than 3% over 14 days
Will {coin}'s realised annualised volatility of daily log returns over the next 7 days exceed 60%?

Is there a scheduled high-impact event for {coin} in the next 24h (token unlock, mainnet/hard fork, ETF decision, major exchange listing/delisting, macro release such as CPI/FOMC)? Answer from your own knowledge only and name it in 'note'.
